scripts.build:web: cd .. && npx expo export --platform web --output-dir electron/dist
scripts.dmg:mac: mkdir -p release && hdiutil create -volname "SimplyMarkdown Viewer" -srcfolder "release/mac-arm64/SimplyMarkdown Viewer.app" -ov -format UDZO "release/SimplyMarkdown Viewer.dmg"
scripts.dist:mac: npm run build:web && npm run pack:mac && npm run sign:mac && npm run dmg:mac
